controles.affirmation: Les couts tarifaires ont contribue a la contraction de six points de la marge brute du trimestre
controles.verbatim_source: As a percentage of Net sales, cost of goods sold increased by 140 basis points to 64.2% in the second quarter of 2026, resulting in gross profit margin contracting to 35.8%. Approximately five percentage points of gross profit margin EXPANSION were driven by favorable price realization, improved operational productivity, higher volume and the impact of acquisitions, MORE THAN OFFSET BY six percentage points of gross profit margin contraction due to material and other cost inflation, including tariff expense and higher intangible amortization expense.
controles.correction_proposee: La marge brute du trimestre s'est contractee de 1,4 point (37,2% a 35,8%), pas de six points. Les six points sont une composante brute defavorable, compensee a hauteur de cinq points par l'expansion (prix, productivite, volume, acquisitions). La citation de l'ATT coupe justement la partie '+cinq points d'expansion... more than offset by', ce qui rend le chiffre trompeur. Reformuler: 'les couts tarifaires et l'amortissement des incorporels ont pese six points de marge brute, compenses a hauteur de cinq points par les prix et la productivite, pour une contraction nette de 1,4 point'. A noter que l'ATT enonce d'ailleurs correctement -1,4 point dans sa section fondamental_interne: incoherence interne.

controles.affirmation: Hubbell a demande le remboursement d'environ 30 M$ de tarifs deja payes, mais ne comptabilise ce gain eventuel qu'une fois quasi certain
controles.verbatim_source: Subsequent to June 30, 2026, the Company RECEIVED REFUNDS for IEEPA tariffs previously paid totaling approximately $30 million, including an immaterial amount of interest. As of June 30, 2026 these amounts were not deemed to be realized or realizable and, accordingly, these amounts were not recognized in the condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ending June 30, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Le 10-Q ne dit pas que Hubbell a 'demande' 30 M$: il dit que la societe a DEJA RECU environ 30 M$ de remboursements apres le 30 juin 2026, simplement non encore comptabilises dans les comptes arretes au 30 juin. La citation de l'ATT fusionne deux phrases distinctes par des points de suspension et supprime 'the Company received refunds'. Reformuler: 'Hubbell a recu environ 30 M$ de remboursements apres le 30 juin 2026, non encore comptabilises au 30 juin en application de la regle de gain contingency'. Consequence: la ligne 'ce_qui_affaiblirait' qui presente le remboursement comme hypothetique doit etre revue, l'encaissement etant deja intervenu.

controles.affirmation: Les droits de douane IEEPA ont ete invalides par la Cour supreme le 20 fevrier 2026 (Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump)
controles.verbatim_source: On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump invalidating certain tariffs previously imposed under the IEEPA.
controles.correction_proposee: Contexte utile omis: 'The IEEPA tariffs were immediately replaced with tariffs under alternative statutory authority, although the scope and duration of future tariffs remain uncertain.' L'invalidation n'a donc pas supprime l'exposition tarifaire.
